description: A turn.complete hook arms one timer per answer of the main conversation and keeps the answer's time in $.state, so a session.start after a reload re-arms it for the rest of the stretch; when it fires with no turn running, within cutoffMinutes and with messages over minMessageTokens, $.session.compact runs with the Compact Instructions section, and otherwise a transcript line says which check skipped it. A session.compact hook hands that section to every other compaction of the main conversation, joined before any instructions typed after /compact.
